topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic on the initiation and resolution of inflammation and outlines what will be covered.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition of Infection and Damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the molecular mechanisms, receptor families, and signaling complexes through which the innate immune system senses pathogen-associated and damage-associated molecular patterns.

topics.label: Leukocyte Recruitment, Trafficking, and Inflammatory Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells initiate the inflammatory response, coordinate leukocyte extravasation and lymphatic trafficking, and how excessive activation causes systemic shock.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms that shut down inflammation, promote tissue healing, and the physiological consequences when inflammation fails to resolve.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks and announces the subject of the next lecture.
